# Multi-Bundle Compatibility

Evaluate bundles together by responsibility, not by repository. Multiple patterns may coexist when they own different layers, such as a Python semantic core, LP Emulator composition, PySpark partition adapter, and deployment configuration. Reject multiple active implementations of the same business formula.

The compatibility matrix must compare target requirement, source ADR context, runtime family, assumptions, dependencies, evidence status, conflicts, semantic owner, adapter owner, selected status, and rejection/defer reason. Human approval selects exact pattern IDs and target paths after the preview is complete.
